notes: S4.2 overgeneralizes the history relationship by stating that prev_sample always equals signal_in sampled at the previous non-reset edge. A synchronous reset clears prev_sample to 0 without sampling signal_in, so a reset can break this relationship. For example, if the previous non-reset edge sampled signal_in=1 and a reset edge then occurs, prev_sample becomes 0 although the previous non-reset sample was 1. The property therefore requires a no-intervening-reset or current-reset-epoch condition. Final RTL is correct and passes trusted simulation and bounded formal verification.
